episodes.title: MAGA Bimbo Cult
episodes.description: Content warning: This episode discusses sexualized online material, psychological distress, dissociation, coercive control, online manipulation, and strong sexual language. It is not medical, psychological, or therapeutic advice. Some voices are disguised or recreated to protect identities; listener discretion is advised. In this episode, the investigation examines an account from “AK,” who says they encountered a person using the name Apex in a private Bambi Sleep Discord community. AK describes alleged manipulation, threats, intense hypnosis experiences, and increasingly politicized and non-consensual themes in the content shared there. The episode also considers why hypnosis communities may appeal to some trans and gender-questioning people, and how practices and community dynamics can become harmful when consent and personal boundaries are undermined. The claims about Apex and the alleged plans described in the episode are presented as AK's account; the transcript notes there is no hard evidence that the proposed compound plans were real. WARNING: Some excerpts may contain language, phrases, or audio associated with Bambi Sleep recordings that listeners could find triggering or unsettling. Any audio excerpts are included for journalistic and documentary purposes, not as instructions or invitations to participate. Featured expert voices: Professor Emily Setty, Associate Professor in Criminology, UNiversity of Surrey Dr Jamie Hakim, Senior Lecturer in Media and Cultural Studies, King's College London Michaela Gorman, Digital Editor & Journalist Listener Support & Resources The Bambi Trap explores sensitive subjects including psychological manipulation, sexual coercion, consent, identity and emotional distress. If you have experienced unwanted psychological influence, coercive behaviour, sexual exploitation or distress related to online communities, support is available. You do not need to identify your experience as abuse or establish that a crime occurred to seek advice or support. If you are in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services. The Bambi Trap and its producers are independent of the organizations listed above. The Bambi Trap is an independent investigative documentary. This series explores online hypnosis, sexuality, consent and allegations of psychological manipulation. It includes personal testimony, opinions and expert commentary. Experiences and allegations reflect contributors' accounts and should not be considered independently verified facts unless expressly stated. Some names, identifying details and voices have been altered or recreated to protect contributors. The series does not imply criminal wrongdoing or suggest that individual experiences represent the wider Bambi Sleep or erotic hypnosis communities. Expert opinions are those of the individuals expressing them and do not necessarily reflect the producers' views.
